eyebrow: TELVERGENCE × Orlando Bankruptcy Firm · Chapter 7 · Chapter 13 · Central Florida
h1a: Every call is someone out of options.
tagline: Someone facing a foreclosure sale date or a garnishment calls a bankruptcy attorney once — usually at night, usually terrified, usually after the letter arrives. If it goes to voicemail, they call the next firm. We turn this practice into a 10-line Smart-DID grid where every consultation call is answered live, in the caller's language, and routed to intake while they still have time to act.
demoNote: Central Florida consumer bankruptcy campaign · Chapter 7 · Chapter 13 · foreclosure · garnishment · 10-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a consumer bankruptcy matter is a $1,500–$6,000 engagement — but the call comes at the worst moment of someone's life, and it comes once. Foreclosure sale dates, wage garnishments, and repossession notices all carry hard deadlines. The firm that answers live, at 9pm, is the firm that gets retained. A phone number that just rings can't do that. A Smart DID can.

dids.p: Priority ring, never voicemail — the line that owns your #1 promise: a free, confidential consultation.
Routes Spanish callers to a bilingual intake path — a Central Florida necessity.
Hard-deadline callers jump the queue and reach intake immediately.
The volume matter, separately tracked and staffed.
The higher-value plan matter, routed to the attorney who handles them.
The homeowner in default — the most time-sensitive inbound you get.
Proves ad ROI to the dollar — swap the number, keep the data.
Attorneys and credit counselors who refer matters to you.
Your outbound face for returning consultation calls — branded and recorded.

pillars.p: This practice runs inbound and referral only. Consumer debtors are the most protected class of callers under TCPA and FDCPA-adjacent rules, so we do not cold-call them — we make sure the person who is already reaching for you gets a human being.
10 tracked lines + round-the-clock live answer + SMS. Every source measured, emergency filings prioritized, every missed call auto-called-back within minutes.
Calls, texts, consultations booked, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which dollar produced which retained client.

commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your intake team reviews on the fly — then you adjust the intake script, territory, or channel and watch the consultation calendar fill. You practice law — we make sure the phone is answered.
